about: SSM PlatformName/PlatformVersion -> OSV ecosystem, read by cve.osv-packages. `platform` is a regex on PlatformName; `version` a regex on PlatformVersion whose first group fills {v}; `download` is the top-level OSV ecosystem zip `cloudtools cve update-db` fetches. Amazon Linux and Windows are deliberately absent: an instance on them gets a gap that points at Inspector.

skip_packages.why: Kernel packages: SSM Inventory lists binary names (linux-aws, linux-image-*) and OSV keys kernels by source package (linux, linux-aws-6.8, ...). A binary name equal to an unrelated source name matches that kernel line's unfixed CVEs at any version: in the live lab, 2,466 false hits on one Ubuntu 24.04 host (2026-10-29). Inspector maps kernels correctly; a host Inspector doesn't cover gets a gap.
